enrichment.summary: Configures strict anti-phishing protections in Defender for Office 365, including aggressive phishing detection, DMARC enforcement, impersonation protection for organisational domains, and safety tips.
enrichment.rationale: Helps organisations minimise the risk of phishing attacks by enforcing advanced detection mechanisms and protecting high-risk users and domains from impersonation attempts.
enrichment.licensing: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 Plan 2 (Microsoft 365 E5)
